action.query: IRS pay federal taxes online official
queries: IRS pay federal taxes online official

annotations.title: Direct Pay with bank account | Internal Revenue Service

content.text:
You can pay **U.S. federal taxes online** through the IRS here:

**IRS payments page:** ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments?os=dio&ref=app&utm_source=openai))  
Use **IRS Direct Pay** if you want to pay from a checking/savings account for free. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/directpay?utm_source=openai))

**Main options:**
- **IRS Direct Pay** — free bank-account payment for individual income tax, estimated tax, balance due, etc.
- **IRS Online Account** — view balance/payment history and pay.
- **Debit/credit card or digital wallet** — available through IRS-approved processors; fees may apply.
- **EFTPS** — useful for businesses, large payments, or recurring/estimated payments. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments?os=dio&ref=app&utm_source=openai))

**Important:** Make sure the site address is an official **irs.gov** page before entering information. The IRS payment page lists the official options.
